summary: A guide to using Telnet to reach UCSB's Online System. It explains why and how the system was connected, its limitations, the virtual keyboard, and local commands such as help, prefix, shift, duplex mode and logout. It includes examples of logging on and instructing the user Telnet program.

eli5.summary: An instruction sheet for visiting a special computer at the university from far away by typing over the network. It lists the keys and commands you can use and shows sample sessions.

questions: telnet access to ucsb online system
